_meta.description: Test payloads for M-LEAD-INTAKE webhook. Send via POST to the generated webhook URL with Content-Type: application/json.
_meta.usage: Select the scenario key you want to test and POST that object's value to the webhook.

scenario_new_lead_sss._description: Happy path — new SSS lead from Webflow, no existing record. Expect: Airtable record created (Status=NEW, Agent_Status=HUMAN_REVIEW), LEAD_CREATED audit event, NEW_LEAD Slack alert with urgency=MEDIUM in #sss-leads.

lead_data.notes: Looking for a sunset sailing package with catering. Celebrating a bachelorette party.

scenario_new_lead_mare_executive._description: New MARE EXECUTIVE lead from API. Expect: Airtable record created, LEAD_CREATED audit event, NEW_LEAD Slack alert in #me-leads (not #sss-leads).

lead_data.notes: Corporate retreat. Need full catering, AV equipment, and concierge services.

scenario_duplicate_lead._description: Duplicate submission — same email as scenario_new_lead_sss. Expect: NO new Airtable record. Existing record Notes and Updated_At updated. LEAD_DUPLICATE audit event. NEW_LEAD Slack alert with urgency=LOW and metadata.duplicate=true.

lead_data.notes: Following up — also interested in the all-inclusive add-on.

scenario_staging_environment._description: Staging environment test. Expect: Airtable record created with Environment='staging'. Confirms environment field is written correctly.

lead_data.notes: Staging environment test submission. Do not process.

scenario_minimal_lead._description: Minimal payload — only required fields. Tests that optional fields (phone, notes, package_interest) are handled gracefully when empty.
